en: Vintage postcard back with multilingual heading 'Postkarte – Carte postale' and equivalents in many European languages, printed in red. At the upper right there is a red Spanish postage stamp marked 'ESPAÑA' with a value of 10 céntimos, cancelled with a circular postmark. The address is handwritten in blue ink and directed to 'Sr Don Benito Pérez Galdós, Palacio "San Quintín", Santander'. The card has dotted red guide lines for writing.
